files.rationale: Kept PR B's dated 5.7.1 release entries (including its reworded #513 line) and new 5.7.2 threshold-lines section, and appended PR A's grouping-related Fixed, Changed and Added entries to the 5.7.1 section, dropping only the duplicate smart picker line.

Both sides added the same favorites-section guard, so PR A's version was taken because it also includes the item-type-qualified sublist ID ('dataset-' + item_type + '-' + parent), which matches the ulSublist ID that the merged file now generates.
